name: Mormonism
overview: Scripture warns believers to discern true prophecy from false, emphasizing that a prophet whose words do not come to pass is not sent by the LORD (Deuteronomy 18:22) and cautioning against false prophets who appear harmless but are inwardly destructive (Matthew 7:15). The Bible affirms the uniqueness and eternality of God, declaring that before Him no other god was formed nor will there be after Him (Isaiah 43:10), and identifies Jesus Christ as the eternal Word who is God (John 1:1). True worship honors God as a Spirit and is offered in spirit and truth (John 4:24), grounded in the reality of Christ’s bodily resurrection, distinguishing Him from mere spirits (Luke 24:39). These truths provide a foundation for evaluating teachings such as Mormonism in light of biblical revelation.
